name: Kai Masumi
source: Kai is a young boy who dreams of being a manga author. He is Seiko’s assistant, and is very loyal to her, in charge of editing her videos and maintaining the channel, and sometimes being her cameraman. He is quite perverted, often trying to get girls to notice him and is a wannabe ladies man. He is also decent at cooking, he enjoys making his homemade curry and often cooks with Akari when she comes over.
